description.value: Grandview Motel is a family-owned and operated two-storey motel situated on a quiet street about 700 m from downtown Kamloops in the Thompson Valley. Guests enjoy rooms with fridges, coffee makers, flat-screen TVs, and optional kitchenettes, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool, gas BBQs, and a shaded picnic area. Pet-friendly and centrally located near Thompson Rivers University and Royal Inland Hospital, it offers a practical and affordable overnight base for cyclists moving through the interior of BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully operational with a 2026 copyright and active booking system, confirming the motel is open. Free Wi-Fi is corroborated by both OSM (internet_access=wlan) and multiple website passages ('free hi-speed wireless internet', 'Free High-Speed Wi-Fi', 'free internet access station in the lobby'). No mention of bike storage, laundry, breakfast, or any cyclist-specific facilities appears anywhere in the website content; a postal code discrepancy exists between OSM (V2C 3Z4) and the website (V2C 3Z3, consistent across all subpages).
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM records V2C 3Z4 but the website consistently shows V2C 3Z3 across all pages — website value used.
Website prominently lists a secondary contact number (Call or Text 778-694-7223) not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating motel with a live booking website and confirmed contact details; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists in Kamloops.
